high_level_description: stc brand style, a business meeting of four colleagues seated around a wooden conference table.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern office with wooden wall paneling in vertical slats, warm lighting from wall-mounted sconces and a table lamp with a white shade, a neutral gray wall, and a small green plant.

elements.desc: Two men wearing traditional Saudi thobes and red and white checkered shemagh headdresses, seated on the left.
A woman wearing a purple hijab and traditional clothing, seated on the right.
A woman wearing black clothing, seated beside her.
